facts.claim: Median private B2B SaaS gross revenue retention fell to 84% in 2025 while annual net revenue retention compressed to 101%
facts.excerpt: The median SaaS gross revenue retention rate fell to 84% in 2025; annual NRR compressed to 101% across all private B2B SaaS.

facts.claim: Net revenue retention splits hard by contract size: 97% under 25,000 dollars ACV, about 108% from 25,000 to 100,000, and 118% above that
facts.excerpt: Enterprise (over $100K ACV) at a median 118% NRR, mid-market ($25K-$100K ACV) at about 108%, and SMB (under $25K ACV) at 97%.

facts.claim: Gross revenue retention by contract size runs 82% under 25,000 dollars ACV, 88% from 25,000 to 100,000, and 95% above
facts.excerpt: SMB (<$25K ACV): 82% GRR; Mid-Market ($25K-$100K): 88% GRR; Enterprise (>$100K ACV): 95% GRR.

facts.claim: Median recovery of involuntary churn is 47.6%, with top performers reaching 70% to 85%
facts.excerpt: The industry median recovery rate for involuntary churn is 47.6%, with top-performer recovery reaching 70-85%.

facts.claim: Between 20% and 40% of total subscription churn is payment failure rather than cancellation
facts.excerpt: Companies that measure only active cancellations miss the 20 to 40% of total churn driven by payment failures.

facts.claim: Median first-month renewal runs 42% to 61% by category, with Business highest at 61% and Social & Lifestyle lowest at 42%
facts.excerpt: Median first renewal rate ranges from 42-61% between categories; Business achieves 61%, Social & Lifestyle 42%.
